edits.rationale: h1 unit 0 is dead on nominal; negative weight on friction_est makes it fire only at low friction (wet)
bias keeps the gate off at nominal friction and on when wet
wet gate suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 unit 24

h2 unit 0 lowers alpha_v on wet states
h2 unit 0 raises brake on wet states, within value limit

hypothesis: A wet-surface gate on h1 unit 0 (dead on nominal) reads friction_est. When wet, it suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 units and drives dead h2 unit 0 to lower alpha_v and raise brake, so the vehicle slows in curves and stays under the friction limit.
expected_effect: On wet curve states the vehicle slows and lat_accel_ratio stays well below 1.0 (rollouts on seeds 50000-50006 gave max ratio about 0.12-0.22 and no failures). Nominal outputs are unchanged (zero offline shift). Route completion on wet scenarios is reduced because the vehicle drives slowly.
